request.style: English, ethereal female solo voice, ancient celtic choir, hammered dulcimer, bodhran, acoustic guitar, harp, mysterious and epic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A great eagle with wings so wide
Came down to Lebanon's pride
Took the top of the cedar tree
Carried it to a foreign see
Planted it in merchant soil
Beside the water, low and toil
It grew a vine with branches spread
Its roots reached out as it fed

[Verse]
But another eagle stood nearby
With thick and heavy plumage dry
The vine bent its roots toward him
Seeking water in his rim
It had good soil and rain
To bear fruit without vain strain
But it turned to a second king
And broke the sacred, holy thing

[Chorus]
I will take a sprig from the top
From the lofty cedar's crop
And plant it on a high mountain
Where the birds in shade are wanting
It will become a majestic tree
Where all the birds shall be

[Verse]
The king of Babylon came strong
Took the crown and led it along
Made a covenant with the prince
Swore an oath for the defense
But he rebelled and sent envoys
To Egypt for horses and toys
He broke the oath and despised the vow
In Babylon he shall now bow

[Chorus]
I will take a sprig from the top
From the lofty cedar's crop
And plant it on a high mountain
Where the birds in shade are wanting
It will become a majestic tree
Where all the birds shall be

[Bridge]
I bring down the high and lift the low
I make the dry and dead tree grow
All the trees of the field will know
That I, the Lord, am the power

[Outro]
I, the Lord, have spoken and will do
On the height of the land, it is true
